scope: Version review notes only. Counts and expectation ledgers unchanged; these assertions remain needs_investigation.

findings.observation: Pinned assertions expect structural/tree-related pseudo-classes after ::part() to be syntactically invalid. Current CSS Pseudo 4 draft allows pseudo-classes syntactically after element-backed pseudo-elements; structural, :has, :scope and :host selectors never match instead.
findings.decision: Do not introduce syntax rejections just to clear these pinned assertions. Review pinned WPT expectations against the intended specification revision; no exclusions or expectation changes made.
findings.caveat: This does not establish matching support. Previously fixed :has-related assertions are retained as historical pinned-audit results; those should also be reviewed when changing specification targets.

findings.observation: The pinned tentative test accepts a sibling combinator argument but rejects a child combinator. The open proposal describes a compound-selector argument, which would exclude both.
findings.decision: Keep functional :has-slotted() grammar unchanged pending version review. The unambiguous wrong pseudo-element spelling ::has-slotted(foo) is fixed in this stage.
